His body opened and washed with Zamzam, the Prophet rides Al-Buraq with Gabriel through seven heavens greeting prophets, sees Al-Bait-al-Ma'mur and Sidrat-ul-Muntaha, and fifty prayers are reduced to five.
On the night of his Ascent the Prophet saw tall brown Moses, medium-height Jesus, Malik the keeper of Hell and the Dajjal; angels will guard Medina from the Dajjal.
Gabriel opens the Prophet's chest, washes it with Zamzam and takes him up the heavens past Adam, Idris, Moses, Jesus and Abraham; fifty prayers become five, then he enters Paradise.
The Prophet says none should call him better than Jonah, and recounts his Night Journey: Aaron in the fifth heaven, Moses and Jesus described, and milk chosen over wine.
The Prophet describes Moses, Jesus and Abraham as seen on the night of his Ascension, when he chose milk over wine and was told he had taken the right path.
When Quraysh disbelieve him, Allah shows the Prophet Jerusalem to describe; he recounts his heart washed, the Buraq, prophets in seven heavens and fifty prayers reduced to five.
On the night journey the Prophet chose milk over wine, and when Quraysh disbelieved him Allah displayed Bait-ul-Maqdis before him so he could describe it.
Ibn Abbas said the vision in the verse was an actual sight shown to the Prophet on his night journey, and the cursed tree is the tree of Zaqqum.
Ibn Abbas says the vision of verse 17.60, a trial for mankind, was what the Prophet saw with his eyes on his Night Journey, and the cursed tree is Zaqqum.
